text.title: Stocks fall as AI doubts, Nvidia SEC probe and tech outages weigh; VIX jumps
text.summary: U.S. stocks closed lower across the board: the S&P 500 fell 1.0%, the Nasdaq 0.7%, the Dow 1.6% and the Russell 2000 1.5%. The VIX rose 11.1% to 25.5. Doubts about the AI boom, Nvidia's CEO exit and a string of tech outages weighed ahead of Nvidia's earnings after the close.

drivers.t: Stocks finished lower as doubts about the sustainability of the AI boom lingered before Nvidia's results and Anthropic's market debut. The Nasdaq 100 fell about 0.7%.
The WSJ reported the SEC is running a civil probe into whether Nvidia violated investor-disclosure laws, amid CEO Jensen Huang's departure. Nvidia closed lower as investors weighed the fallout.
Outages hit banks, air travel, the NSA and Apple. One analyst said software companies could be "particularly vulnerable" to AI misuse, and Salesforce led S&P 500 decliners.
WSJ's market wrap cited slower retail sales as a drag on stocks. Every S&P sector ended lower, with financials down 1.9% and utilities down 1.6%.
The 10-year Treasury yield slipped 2 bp to 5.10% and the 2-year fell 3 bp to 4.80%. Bloomberg pointed to a haven bid tied to renewed AI jitters.

earnings.t: Nvidia's first report since Huang's exit drew a CNBC headline saying it beat on results and guidance; shares were up 1.9% after hours after closing lower.
